installPwa.title: Install the app
installPwa.description: How to install Kaspi Bot on your phone's home screen.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.description: Sign in to the Kaspi store management dashboard.

pwa.title: Install Kaspi Bot
pwa.description: Add Kaspi Bot to your home screen and open it like a regular app without searching for the website.

steps.share: Tap the Share button in Safari's bottom toolbar.
steps.homeScreen: Scroll down and choose Add to Home Screen.
steps.confirm: Tap Add. The Kaspi Bot icon will appear on your home screen.

steps.menu: Tap the ⋮ menu in the top-right corner.
steps.install: Choose Install app or Add to Home screen.
steps.confirm: Confirm the installation. The Kaspi Bot icon will appear on your home screen.

store.title: Add a store
store.description: Open Stores, click + Store, and complete the form. Connection takes about 15 seconds. A green indicator will appear when it is ready.

product.title: Configure a product
product.description: Open Products, select a product, and click Repricing. Enter the minimum and maximum prices, then save the settings.

priceBot.title: Enable repricing
priceBot.description: Open the Price Bot settings and click Enable repricing. You can also stop it there.

emailLoginInstruction.title: How do I connect a Kaspi store to Kaspi Bot using email?

steps.openUsers: Open Kaspi Seller Cabinet, go to Users, and click Add user.
steps.usePassword: A password will be sent to the email address you entered. Enter that email and the password from the message in Kaspi Bot.
steps.complete: Done. Your store will be connected to Kaspi Bot after these steps.

priceBot.controlDescription: Starts or stops automatic price checks and updates across all active stores.

startConfirm.description: The bot will regularly check configured products in all active stores and may update prices within the min/max range.

stopConfirm.title: Stop Price Bot?
stopConfirm.description: New checks and price updates will stop. Current Kaspi prices will remain unchanged.

makeWorkerConfirm.title: Change role to worker?
makeWorkerConfirm.description: The user will no longer be able to manage other users.

makeAdminConfirm.title: Change role to administrator?
makeAdminConfirm.description: The user will be able to add, remove and change the roles of other users.

removeConfirm.description: The user will lose access to this group. This action cannot be undone.

settings.ignoredCompetitorsHint: Price Bot excludes these sellers when repricing all stores.

stockSettings.title: Product stock
stockSettings.description: Set the product quantity the bot sends to Kaspi during repricing.

validation.title: Invalid product quantity
validation.description: Enter a whole number from 3 to 10,000.

singleProduct.title: How do I change the stock for one product?
singleProduct.content: Disable repricing for the product. Then open the Kaspi seller cabinet and change its stock manually.

sameQuantity.title: Why does the bot set the same stock for every product?
sameQuantity.content: Our survey found that sellers do not maintain product stock because it takes too much time. It is easier to set it once and forget it.

smallQuantity.title: What happens if I enter a small stock quantity?
smallQuantity.content: If the stock is 2, a customer cannot place one order for 3 units.
